component.name: con
component.summary: GPU-accelerated terminal emulator with a built-in AI agent harness

description.p: con is a modern, GPU-accelerated terminal emulator and developer workspace equipped with a built-in AI agent harness, multi-pane multiplexing, seamless tmux control, and integrated editor and preview surfaces.

ul.li: GPU-accelerated terminal rendering backed by libghostty-vt and GPUI
Built-in AI agent harness with context-aware tool execution and assistance
Native multi-pane layout, split surfaces, and bidirectional tmux integration
Integrated file tree, lightweight code editor with LSP support, and markdown preview
Scriptable CLI control surface via con-cli

screenshot.caption: con GPU-accelerated terminal emulator and AI workspace

description.p: Initial stable release of con terminal emulator.
